nodes.title: SG-8.2 Contribution textarea input validation
nodes.body:
Context: ContributionSheet (game/frontend/src/components/ContributionSheet.tsx) only silently ignores an empty trimmed prompt, has no maximum length or counter, and still allows submit when remaining is 0. Desired behavior: block blank/whitespace-only text, enforce a max length with a visible counter and inline message, and block submit at zero quota with a clear message. Expected result: invalid input never reaches submitContribution and the player sees why. Why: clear feedback and fewer wasted backend calls.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given empty or whitespace-only text, when the player tries to submit, then no request is sent and an inline message is shown
- Given text over the maximum length, when shown, then the counter and an inline message indicate the overflow and submit is blocked
- Given remaining quota is 0, when the sheet is open, then submit is blocked and a clear message is shown


## Scope
- In scope: ContributionSheet textarea validation, counter, inline messages, quota gating
- Out of scope: Backend changes
- Out of scope: History list changes
- Out of scope: Dialog wrapper changes
- Preserve: submitContribution and listMine API contracts
- Preserve: Dialog focus and Escape behavior
- Preserve: Existing sending/sent/failed states


## Technical constraints
- React + TypeScript in game/frontend
- Backend default max_prompt_len is 500 (backend/internal/config/config.go)
- No new dependencies


## Definition of done
- All three requirements delivered with passing unit tests


## Non-functional requirements
- Messages are exposed to assistive tech via role or aria-describedby


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Blank or whitespace-only text cannot be submitted and shows an inline message
nodes.body:
Context: handleSubmit returns silently when text.trim() is empty. Desired behavior: the Send button is disabled for blank text and an inline message explains that an idea is required when submit is attempted. Expected result: no submitContribution call for blank input. Why: the player gets feedback instead of silence.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the textarea is empty or only whitespace, when the sheet renders, then the Send button is disabled
- Given whitespace-only text, when the form is submitted, then submitContribution is not called and an inline message 'Write your idea before sending' is shown


## Scope
- In scope: Blank validation in ContributionSheet
- Out of scope: Length and quota rules
- Preserve: Trimmed prompt sent on valid submit


## Technical constraints
- Keep validation in ContributionSheet.tsx


## Definition of done
- Blank input blocked with a visible message


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Maximum length is enforced with a visible character counter and inline message
nodes.body:
Context: the textarea has no limit while the backend rejects prompts over 500 characters. Desired behavior: a counter shows used/max, and over-limit text shows an inline message and disables Send. Expected result: over-limit prompts are never submitted. Why: avoid avoidable server rejections.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the textarea holds N characters, then a counter reads 'N/500'
- Given the trimmed text exceeds 500 characters, then an inline message 'Idea is too long' is shown and Send is disabled
- Given the text is exactly 500 characters, then Send is enabled and no length message is shown


## Scope
- In scope: MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH constant, counter, over-limit message
- Out of scope: Reading the limit from the backend
- Preserve: Existing textarea id contribution-idea


## Technical constraints
- Constant lives in game/frontend/src/api/client.ts beside MAX_PER_PLAYER


## Definition of done
- Counter visible and over-limit blocked


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Submit is blocked with a clear message when the remaining quota is 0
nodes.body:
Context: remaining is computed from sent entries but never gates submit. Desired behavior: when remaining is 0 the Send button and textarea are disabled and a message 'No contributions left this round' is shown. Expected result: no request at zero quota. Why: the player understands why they cannot send.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given 5 sent contributions, when the sheet renders, then Send is disabled and 'No contributions left this round' is shown
- Given 4 sent contributions, when the sheet renders, then Send is enabled and no quota message is shown


## Scope
- In scope: Quota gating in ContributionSheet
- Out of scope: Backend quota logic
- Preserve: Contributions left counter text


## Technical constraints
- Use existing remaining value derived from entries


## Definition of done
- Zero quota blocks submit with message


## Clarifying questions
- None
